page.notes: Head INDEX treated as the title of the index (level 1) and also as the running head. Doubtful readings: "Sebsn" (second word of the line, may be a misprint for Sehsn or a name); "Solu" (likely Solis, marked); "Revolutio" read with a consonant v; "exacte" may carry an accent, not certain. "Rebuspub." and "de scriptiones" are as printed, with possible errors. Line "Satanas ... malagit" is a reading of a broken word; the printed text near "nisi" is partly obscured. The line "Sophistae ... lesuita" and "Shimei" are as printed. Some page references are blurred and may be misread.
